svg.title: Player one: who I am
svg.desc: Senior software engineer with 10+ years across the full software development life cycle. 50+ AWS microservices on a platform he helped build and support; 3,000 to 1,000-line Python refactor with +20% performance; PyTest coverage above 85% on new code; 5 domains; led backend teams at Freddie Mac and Humana and API development at CVS Health.
svg.text: Now: FastAPI microservices on AWS EKS/ECS serving ML
forecasting models at Freddie Mac. Backend, cloud,
Humana; led API dev at CVS
